annotations.title: Buscar e-mail do decisor da empresa

description: For small businesses (a school, a market, a clinic), finds the e-mail address of who decides there (personal data). Takes 1 to 25 entries in people, looked up 5 at a time. Each business is identified by its name and city, its CNPJ, its site domain or a phone it publishes. First it checks this workspace (people sheets, campaigns and kept briefs): a value already saved comes back free, with savedIn naming where it was saved; refresh true skips that check. Otherwise it asks Nock's data sources one after another and stops at the first that finds it. value is the decision maker's e-mail address. Nothing is written into a sheet or a campaign. Returns one entry per person or business in the order sent (index), each with person (whose it is), status found, not_found or error, value and creditsCharged, plus the totals found, notFound, failed and creditsCharged. not_found with sourcesUnanswered means some sources did not answer in time and a later try may find it; error means no source answered. The same entry sent twice is looked up once (sameAsIndex). Costs 8 credits per value found. Nothing is charged when it is not found, the lookup fails or the value was already saved. A lookup can take up to about a minute per entry.

people.description: Who to look up, 1 to 25 entries, each with what is known of them.

cnpj.description: The business's CNPJ (Brazilian company registry number), when known.

companyDomain.description: The business's site domain, when known.

location.description: The business's city (and state), with companyName.

phone.description: A phone number the business publishes, when known.

refresh.description: True skips what this workspace has saved and looks the value up outside again.
